description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Grid_Lines, which extends Image_Graph_Grid, and is responsible for rendering line grids on a plot area within the PEAR Image_Graph library. It includes methods for constructing the grid object and outputting the grid lines based on axis points.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid_Lines
classes.description: A class that displays a line grid on a plot area, extending the Image_Graph_Grid class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grid and sets the line style to light grey.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the grid lines on the canvas based on primary and secondary axis points.
